title: Good quality, little variety.
text: We have only had it for 3 months the so far, and I am impressed with the quality of items we have recieved, at a good price point. HOWEVER, disappointed that all 3 items received are toys. Something like a butterfly hatch kit would be way cooler, imo, than another building set, one after the other. Or an ant farm, something that requires the kids to mix art with science, science experiments, etc. Don't get me wrong. I live building sets, but so far that is all we have been sent. I hope there is some variety soon.
label: neutral
